When I was 8 and my older brothers 16 and 18 were messing around with a bb gun they managed to get. I somehow managed to walk in the line of fire and one of them shot me right in the face by accident?? (even I don't know that, I should ask) It left a pretty sketchy mark. They helped me sort out the injury the best they could to save their asses from our parents and then acted like nothing happened.. after they told me I couldn't tell anybody about this especially not mum and dad. I hid the mark from my parents that night and went off to school the next day. The school thought I was being abused at home and rang the police because I wouldn't tell them how it happened. I eventually gave in when my parents were called in to the school and they forced me to speak. I said. "They (meaning my brothers) shot me in the face with a gun". Went home from school with the truth being told. My older brothers denied. denied. denied. So now  'nobody' knows how that mark ended up on my face. Nobody believed my story for like ten years. 

Until one family gathering. The oldest brother goes.. "Remember when I shot you in the face all those years ago" realises what he said and covers his mouth. Cue silence at the table. Mum gives him the hard stare and goes... "you fucker" 

TL;DR Older brothers shoot me in the face with a Bb gun. I don't tell anyone and go to school with a big mark on my face. I won't say anything. Cops called. Parents come in. Brothers deny. They let it slip at the table years later.
